subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: What canonical selected-versus-resolved model and cost semantics should routed provider responses expose across agent, session, and footer surfaces?
rationale: This cannot be safely resolved as an OpenRouter-only formatting patch because the choice affects persisted session identity, routing proxies, fallback reporting, plugin hooks, and whether the displayed amount means account charge or upstream inference cost.

options.title: Separate resolved metadata
options.body: Preserve the selected alias, add distinct per-turn resolved model/provider fields, display OpenRouter’s account charge as authoritative, and retain cost details for diagnostics.

options.title: Replace model identity
options.body: Persist the routed backend as the model used for the turn and allow it to replace the session’s active model identity.

options.title: Split model and cost delivery
options.body: Land generic routed-model metadata first and leave user-visible authoritative cost to the existing cost-contract issue.

recommendation.title: Separate resolved metadata
recommendation.body: Preserve the selected alias, add distinct per-turn resolved model/provider fields, display OpenRouter’s account charge as authoritative, and retain cost details for diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They previously reviewed this exact product question and have recent ownership signals on the session-status surfaces affected by the decision.
